text:
Nora: quick follow-up from RFC: we still don't have a clean affinity model for when to route requests to fp8 vs int8 vs fp32. want a short decision we can implement this week.
Tariq: big constraints: 1) avoid cache fragmentation, 2) deterministic canaries, 3) predictable billing labels.
Jules: proposal: two-tier signal: client hint header (X-Fidelity: quality|balanced|cost) + server-resolved affinity tag (affinity_id) used for cache and billing. hint not part of cache key.
Maya: runtime pins affinity_id at request start. mapping resolution only at ingress and cached in mapping-service for 5m per-tenant to avoid oscillation.
Nora: fallback chain must be explicit per-model (e.g., fp8-v1 -> int8-std -> int8-safe -> fp16). runtime falls back on quant-fail or memory pressure and emits an audit event.
Tariq: telemetry: track per-affinity_id cohorts with metrics: kl_mean, nll_delta, token_error_rate. alert rules: kl_mean>0.1 warn, >0.18 critical; token_error_rate delta >0.03 critical.
Jules: add hourly shadow-eval sampling: 0.1% online requests forked to fp32 baseline + candidate profile. compute KL and emit cohort signal.
Maya: ops CLI snippets for runbook:
```
redwood quant affinity status --model llama-3
redwood quant affinity set --tenant=acme --model=llama-3 --affinity=fp32-safe
```
Nora: billing: attach affinity_billing_tag to request metadata and surface line-item. tenants can set monthly affinity caps that auto-downgrade when hit.
Tariq: deterministic canaries: select tenants by hash(tenant_id)%10000 < threshold. keep selection stable across mapping updates for the TTL.
Jules: open question: allow hosted customers to pin affinity? suggest no for hosted; only Dedicated/Private can pin directly. hosted can request via support.
Maya: ops-bot -> if auto-fallback rate > 0.5% for 10m, create INC ticket and notify @Maya @Nora.
ops-bot: noted. created ticket INC-2026-1107 and subscribed @Maya @Nora.
Nora: action items: Jules write mapping API spec (PR by Tue), Tariq add telemetry dims & thresholds (PR + dashboard by Wed), Maya draft runbook + CLI docs (by Fri). closing, will post PR links here.
